request.title: Petrobras announces 2026 production guidance and capex plan
request.summary: Petrobras said it will raise its own oil production and increase capital expenditure on pre-salt fields. The company detailed its drilling schedule and capex budget for the next five years.

request.title: Petrobras cuts production after a major platform accident
request.summary: Petrobras halted output at a Campos Basin platform following a serious operational accident. The company warned of lower near-term production and extra repair costs.

request.title: Oil companies rise after crude jumps on tighter supply
request.summary: Shares of Exxon, Shell, BP and Petrobras moved higher with the broader oil sector after a jump in crude prices. No company-specific operational update was provided.

request.title: Brazilian central bank holds the Selic rate
request.summary: Brazil's central bank kept the benchmark interest rate unchanged. Banks including Bradesco were mentioned among financial stocks that reacted to the macro decision.

request.title: Oil companies rise after Strait of Hormuz disruption fears
request.summary: Crude jumped after reports of tension in the Strait of Hormuz. Shares of Exxon, Shell, BP and Petrobras moved higher along with the broader oil sector. No company-specific operational update was provided.

request.title: Ibovespa closes mixed as banks outperform
request.summary: Brazilian equities were mixed. Vale and Itau led gains, while several other names including a brief mention of Petrobras were little changed on light volume.

request.title: Petrobras beats earnings estimates but faces a new regulatory probe
request.summary: Petrobras reported stronger-than-expected quarterly profit while disclosing a new regulatory investigation that may lead to fines. The company raised cash generation guidance and warned about legal uncertainty.
